acceptance_criteria: With two open sessions and the pointer on one, chough evidence add --session <other>, and the same command with CHOUGH_SESSION=<other>, record into the other session and leave the pointer unchanged, and chough next --session <other> shows that session. A --session or CHOUGH_SESSION naming an archived or unknown session refuses with every file unchanged. chough init --session and chough inbox add --session keep their meaning, and session new and session use ignore CHOUGH_SESSION. The five versioned hc templates in integrations/ tell the agent to export CHOUGH_SESSION for its session.

answers.constraints: The specs/cli/cli.3md lesson on native tasks applies: human gates are listed as plain text in tasks.md, not as checkboxes, and the delta is frozen at approval. An hc template change appends a new version entry to integrations/templates.toml and never edits a listed one (REQ-cli-065). No other lesson or principle constrains it.
